results.notes: UA = bike d3fd1b30 (only unbranded analysis in QA-GEO; the "Postal services" analysis is not on staging, so the expected "P" / "Postal services" read "B" / "bike"). Steps 1-4: column header "Brand / Topic"; bike row = red letter avatar "B" + "bike", no domain. Steps 5-8: sidebar block = "B" avatar (logo slot) + "bike"; no "Unbranded analysis" label, no date, no header. Steps 22-24: Sort by Sentiment groups 11 Positive, then 21 Mixed, then 13 Negative, frequency decreasing inside each group, no score. Steps 25-26: each filter lists only its polarity, counts 11 / 21 / 13 = pills; All gives 45 again. Steps 27-29: "bike fit" panel header "13% frequency • Positive" (white pill on green), no score, no gauge. Steps 30-32: subtitle "How the answers split across entities", 11 slices all radius 116, no centre value, top 10 + Others 33%, sum 100%. Steps 33-35: "bike landscape", all rows same class, header tooltips (Visibility %, Avg Position, AI Choice %) never say "your brand". Steps 36-38: subtitle "See which domains AI Engines reference most often for your topic", legend = source types (no Owned / Competitor Media), columns Domain / Type / Frequency. Steps 39-40: pinkbike.com > All related Prompts: tabs ALL, Visibility 10, Competitive 5, Category Topics 3; no Perception tab. Sort restored to Frequency.

results.notes: UA = bike d3fd1b30 (only unbranded analysis in QA-GEO; the "Postal services" analysis is not on staging, so the expected "P" / "Postal services" read "B" / "bike"). C1 = Mountain Bikes, C2 = Road Bikes, BA = Toyota 439acd96. Steps 1-4: no KPI card / delta; InBrief 3 bullets about Mountain Bikes + "Category summary generated by artificial intelligence"; "Top Topics in the Category" 21 topics, no brand; SOV ring 11 slices radius 116, no centre value; landscape rows one style. Step 5: Mountain Bikes tabs All 31 / Visibility 10 / Competitive 7 / Category Topics 14, no Other tab (count 0, hidden), no Perception (note: Road Bikes shows "Competitive 0" as a tab). Steps 6-7: Category Topics rows show theme chips (+N); "What makes Mountain Bikes good quality?" panel badge "Category Topics", never "Perception". Steps 8-10: "Most popular Mountain Bikes?" (Visibility): ChatGPT ranking #1 Specialized, Gemini #1 Specialized; row winner "Specialized"; no favourability filter or count. Steps 11-14: "Most popular for Mountain Bikes: Santa Cruz, Trek, Specialized or Yeti?": "Specialized was chosen", full ranking 1 Specialized, 2 Trek, 3 Santa Cruz, 4 Yeti, no target brand block. Steps 17-18 checked on the Other category page (only place with Other prompts): tab "Other 3" comes last after the type tabs, rows carry the "Other" badge and theme chips (+N), no winner. Steps 19-23: sidebar Mountain Bikes, Road Bikes, then "Other"; Other page tabs Identity + Sources (no Performance), InBrief, Top Topics (14), Prompts Analysis; no KPI, SOV, Time Evolution, prioritization or rankings. Steps 24-28: pills Positive / Mixed / Negative without count; Sort by Sentiment = 5 Positive, 7 Mixed, 2 Negative, frequency decreasing; "advanced geometry" panel "33% frequency • Positive", no score, no gauge. Steps 29-32: "New bikes" (Other / Other): engine control ChatGPT / Gemini, badge "SENTIMENT - CHATGPT" Positive, themes, Response, Sources + "All sources"; Gemini: "SENTIMENT - GEMINI" Mixed, other themes and response. Steps 33-36: bike sidebar has no Action Center; Toyota keeps "Action Center". Steps 37-39: /dashboard/d3fd1b30.../actions redirects to the bike Overview. Sort restored to Frequency.

results.notes: Toyota 439acd96, period Last 7 days (3-9 Nov 2026): the precondition period 28 Sept - 4 Oct could not be picked (date picker shows Oct-Nov only; not pursued). Files saved in the scratchpad exports/ folder. Step 1: "Export analysis" icon > "EXPORT ANALYSIS AS": PDF, Presentation .pptx, Spreadsheet .xls. Steps 2-8 (PPTX, 17 slides, parsed from slide XML): slide 17 = "ACTION CENTER · TARGET SOURCES", "Where PR effort pays first", "Top 10 of 91 verified target sources · every claim checked against the page itself"; no Action Center slide elsewhere; cards #1 guideautoweb.com, #2 largus.fr, #3 youtube.com, table 4-10 autobild.es, larepubliquedespyrenees.fr, edmunds.com, leveil.fr, autoplus.fr, automobile-magazine.fr, autojournal.fr = Action Center ALL tab ranks 1-10 (91 sources) with the same counts (e.g. guideautoweb "Not visible in 19 articles · Negative perception in 8 articles"). Steps 9-11: slides 4 / 11 / 15 rows "89 sources • Positive" + 45% etc., no score, no barometer. Step 10 PARTIAL: Positive and Mixed (Bruit du moteur) checked; the only Negative concept (Cout d achat, 3%) is not in the top 10 shown on the slides for this period. Steps 12-18 (PDF, 17 pages; text is outlined, so pages 4, 16 and 17 were rendered with pdf.js and read): page 17 = Action Center slide identical to the PPTX; page 16 = VUS sources; page 4 = same 10 concepts as the PPTX. Step 15 PARTIAL: only pages 4, 16, 17 rendered (absence of an Action Center page in the middle not proven page by page; the PPTX with the same structure has none). Step 17 PARTIAL: same Negative limit as step 10. Steps 19-23 (XLSX, sheets Overview, Target Sources, Brand Pillars, Voitures hybrides, VUS, Raw Data): each concepts table header "Concept, Sentiment, Sources, Frequency, Cited by", no Score; Sentiment = Positive / Mixed / Negative (Cout d achat = Negative); the 28 Overview concepts and frequencies equal the "Top Topics Associated with Your Brand" card (Efficacite energetique 89 sources 45%, ...). Steps 24-27: export with Sort by Coverage, then Prompts (cards re-sorted: #1 caranddriver.com 108 prompts, #2 largus.fr 107, #3 autoblog.com 99), export again: Target Sources slide order identical in both files (guideautoweb.com ... autojournal.fr). Sort restored to Coverage.
